propositions: Focused prerequisite consistency Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier must isolate prerequisite material from general reviewer prompts and receive stable whole prerequisite blocks without splitting subject or prerequisite plan text.

Prerequisite coverage output must declare exactly one closed-enum disposition (consistent|finding|indeterminate) per readable pinned canonical ID with schema-enforced prerequisite_id attribution in every finding and deterministic indeterminate reason codes.

Every upheld focused finding must surface in the verdict with its authoritative prerequisite ID using a canonical four-field length-prefixed SHA-256 identity, distinct from legacy pipe-delimited finding IDs.

Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record must force top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict while retaining concurrent DET blockers visibly in the blocking array and setting coverage.prerequisite_indeterminate=true.

Focused Pass-2 verifier attribution must enforce yes|no|na vocabulary with no veto becoming no or na, and incorrect attribution must convert that prerequisite record to indeterminate/attribution-invalid and remove its incompatibility findings.

Singleton focused finder evaluation must achieve recall≥0.90, false-acceptance≤0.10, coverage=1.00, attribution-error=0.00 with packed non-regression gating before production workflow wiring and terminal verdict integration.
